nodes.label: The donor keeps parallel name, time, and points lists, loads triples from input lines, and displays sorted records by points; its save/load operations use URLConnection when online.

nodes.label: ApoMario completes a run in ApoMarioLevel.setAnalysis, changes player points for win/loss outcomes, and transitions to the analysis panel; the level exposes players and passed time for integration.

nodes.label: The donor's highscore loader converts every input line in fixed three-line groups directly to Integer values and appends records without validating numeric ranges, list alignment, or malformed trailing data.
nodes.task_relevance: Copying this parser into the local target store would allow a user-edited file to trigger parse failures or inconsistent records before display.
nodes.verification: Supply malformed, truncated, oversized, negative, and misaligned records to the target parser and assert rejection is reported without partial list publication.

nodes.failure_behavior: When online, the operation transmits the supplied score, time, and name; network failure returns false after the attempted transmission.

nodes.task_relevance: The target feature requires persistence across local runs; the donor network branch should not be copied as the target store operation.
nodes.verification: Inspect the target call graph and run with network monitoring to verify storeRun/persistAcrossRuns perform only Path-local I/O.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report an invalid store record or excessive allocation; the highscore view falls back to an empty in-memory board so the menu effect remains available.

nodes.task_relevance: The store is explicitly a user-editable local file and is read before highscore display.
nodes.verification: Use a temporary Path containing invalid UTF/text, huge counts, extreme integers, missing fields, duplicate rows, and trailing data; verify bounded allocation, explicit rejection, and an empty-board fallback.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report an invalid tuple; do not append a partial row or reorder mismatched parallel lists.

nodes.verification: Store multiple valid tuples in unsorted insertion order, reload them, and assert equal list lengths, tuple alignment, and non-increasing scores.

nodes.verification: Run a one-player clear and loss, including a missing team name, and assert exactly one tuple per run with final score and elapsed time.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report read/write failure or invalid serialized data; use an empty in-memory board for failed reads and retain the already-recorded in-memory tuple when a write fails.

nodes.task_relevance: Protects the local board from user-tampered or integration-supplied tuple values while preserving valid run recording.

summary: ApoIcarus provides a highscore model, sorting/display panel, and run-end submission flow, but its implementation persists through network endpoints. ApoMario already has menu/model/button navigation, level completion transitions, player points/team names, and elapsed-time state; the proposed feature should reuse the data model and panel structure while making the Path-backed store local, validated, and failure-reporting.
